sql: SELECT T2.score, CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_international_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university_ranking_year T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.university_id WHERE T2.year=2015 AND T1.university_id=100

SELECT DISTINCT T3.country_name FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id JOIN country T3 ON T2.country_id=T3.id WHERE T1.year=2013 AND T1.num_students*100 > (SELECT AVG(num_students) FROM university_year)*98
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.university_id WHERE T2.score = 90 AND T1.year = 2011

SELECT SUM(T1.num_students) - SUM(CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_international_students AS REAL)/100) FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Harvard University' AND T1.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_international_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Harvard University' AND T1.year=2012
SELECT CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Stanford University' AND T1.year=2011

SELECT SUM(T1.num_students) - SUM(CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100) FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Emory University' AND T1.year=2011

SELECT T3.country_name, CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id JOIN country T3 ON T2.country_id=T3.id WHERE T1.year=2011 AND T1.university_id=23

SELECT DISTINCT T1.university_name FROM university T1 JOIN university_ranking_year T2 ON T1.id=T2.university_id WHERE T2.year=2015 AND T2.score*100 < (SELECT AVG(score)*28 FROM university_ranking_year WHERE year=2015)
